mapper.insert: insert into water_distributor (name, county, town, village, longitude, latitude, water_supply, date, manage_unit, address, rtu_code, note, create_time, update_time, point) values (#{name}, #{county}, #{town}, #{village}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{waterSupply}, #{date}, #{manageUnit}, #{address}, #{rtuCode}, #{note}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, st_pointfromtext(#{geom}))
